title: Round26 walking checkpoint recovery and reuse
summary: Before continuing Unit09 pixel art, recover Bearframe_Round26_Eight_Direction_Walking_64_Frames.zip from the user's saved files. Read ROUND26_README.md and QA, then use walk_v5, build_walk.py and export_validate.py. The durable recovery guide records exact frame size, pivot, timing, atlas order, protected cardinal baselines, reusable articulation and quantization lessons, rejected approaches and remaining artistic limits. Preserve the working 64-frame walk; do not restart from flat diagonal studies. Numerical validation does not establish final artistic or runtime approval.
